entry.name: autopattr
entry.digest: Expose multiple objects to the pattr system
entry.description: Causes multiple objects within a patcher to be automatically included in the pattr system. Note: you should use only one instance of an autopattr object per level in a patch.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: A symbol argument can be used to set theobject's. In the absence of an argument, theobject is given an arbitrary, semi-random name, such as u197000004.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: autoname
attributes.digest: Auto-name state
attributes.description: The word, followed by a 1 or 0, enables or disables theobject's autoname state. The default is 0 (off). When enabled, theobject will automatically name any unnamed objects in the patcher supported by thesystem and bind to them, if possible. Naming only occurs when the patcher loads, when theobject is again instantiated, or when theobject receives the message. New objects placed in a patcher after thehas been instantiated will not be autonamed until one of these conditions is met.

attributes.name: autorestore
attributes.digest: Auto-restore state
attributes.description: The word, followed by a 1 or 0, enables or disables theobject's autorestore state. The default is 1 (on). When enabled, theobject will automatically output its last-saved values when the patcher is loaded, and distribute them to bound objects. Values are saved whenever the patcher is saved.
